def extract(label, text=alltext):
 m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r'\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n)+)',text)
 if not m: raise ValueError(label)
 return [[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in m.group(1).strip().splitlines()]

 demos.append(([[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in m.group(1).strip().splitlines()], [[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in n.group(1).strip().splitlines()]))
